medieval.description: Tudor / high-medieval European: stone plinths, white plaster between dark timber frames, steep spruce roofs.
medieval.guidance: Cobble/stone foundation 1-2 high. Timber-frame walls: @trim logs at corners and every 3-4 blocks, horizontal beams at each floor line, @wall plaster infill set one block BEHIND the frame for depth. Upper floors may jetty out 1 block. Steep gable roofs (pitch 1) with 1-block overhang, @roof_trim on the gable edges, a stone or brick chimney. Windows 1x2 or 2x2 with trapdoor shutters and a stair/slab sill. Lanterns by doors, flower boxes, paths of dirt_path/gravel.

gothic.description: Gothic cathedral / castle: vertical stone mass, pointed arches, buttresses, steep dark slate roofs, stained glass.
gothic.guidance: Emphasise verticality: tall narrow bays, pointed arches (arch style=pointed), flying or plain buttresses every 4-6 blocks along long walls, pinnacles (cone/spire on buttress tops). Steep roofs (pitch 2) in deepslate tiles. Large stained-glass windows framed by @trim, a rose window (circle of @window) over the main portal. Use @accent chiseled blocks sparingly at portals and string courses. Twin west towers with spires. Mix cracked/mossy variants for age.

fantasy.description: High fantasy / elven / wizard: pale calcite and quartz, teal prismarine roofs, slender towers, organic flourishes.
fantasy.guidance: Slender round towers with tall conical or spire roofs (pitch 2+), many turrets of varying heights, curved or onion domes. Pale @wall with @accent prismarine bands. Large arched windows. Wrap with vines/leaves (@leaves) and flowering azalea. Asymmetry is welcome but keep a clear main axis. Bridges between towers.

japanese.description: Traditional Japanese: raised wooden halls, white plaster panels, red-lacquer posts, deep curved tile roofs with wide eaves.
japanese.guidance: Raise the floor 1-2 blocks on a stone base. Post-and-beam: @column posts (red) at every 3-4 blocks, @trim dark beams, @wall white panels recessed. Very wide eaves (overhang 2) with hip roofs; flare the eave corners up by one block. Pagodas stack shrinking tiers, each with its own hip roof, topped with a spire (fence/end_rod). Engawa veranda with slab floor and fence railing. Gardens: raked gravel @path, cherry @leaves, stone lanterns, water.

nordic.description: Viking / Scandinavian: long halls of spruce, heavy log frames, steep shingle roofs, carved gable crossings.
nordic.guidance: Longhouses (length 2-3x width) with low stone plinth, @trim log frame, @wall planks. Steep gable roofs reaching near the ground, crossed beams (fence/log) projecting past the ridge at each gable end. Few small windows. Torches/lanterns on posts, palisades of logs, wooden docks.

desert.description: Mediterranean / Arabian desert: sandstone masses, flat roofs with parapets, domes, courtyards, arcades.
desert.guidance: Cubic volumes stacked and stepped back, flat roofs with crenellated or slab parapets, domes (sphere half=top) on drums, slender minaret towers. Arcades of round arches around courtyards with fountains. Deep window reveals (inset 1-2). Palm trees (jungle log + leaves), awnings of wool/banners.

modern.description: Contemporary: clean white volumes, cantilevers, flat roofs, floor-to-ceiling glass, warm wood cladding accents.
modern.guidance: Asymmetric interlocking boxes, cantilevered upper floors, large full-height glass walls (use full 'glass' or 'light_gray_stained_glass' blocks), flat roofs with thin slab edges, wood @wall_alt cladding panels, black @accent window frames. Pools (water), terraces with glass railings (glass_pane), hidden lighting (sea_lantern under slabs).

classical.description: Greco-Roman / neoclassical: marble temples, colonnades, pediments, domes, symmetrical facades.
classical.guidance: Strict symmetry. Stepped stylobate base (3 steps of slabs/stairs). Colonnades of @column quartz pillars with @accent capitals and bases, entablature band above columns, low-pitch pediment roof (pitch 0.5 or gable with slabs) with a triangular tympanum. Domes on drums for grand buildings. Terracotta/granite roofs.

dwarven.description: Dwarven / industrial fantasy: monumental deepslate and blackstone, copper accents, massive geometric forms.
dwarven.guidance: Heavy, angular, symmetric. Thick battered walls (wider at base), huge rectangular gateways framed by stepped @accent copper, statues of stacked blocks, hexagonal/octagonal halls, long straight halls with pillar rows. Glowing @window orange glass and lanterns on chains.

rustic.description: Rustic village / farmstead: oak plank cottages, log frames, cobble chimneys, gardens and fences.
rustic.guidance: Small cosy volumes, oak @wall with @trim log corners, cobble foundation, gable roofs with overhang, brick @accent chimneys, fenced gardens, crops, barrels and hay bales as props.
